description: Playing-conditions timeline for the cricket simulator (CRICKET-MODEL-PLAN.md section 5). Layers apply in file order; a layer applies when every 'when' key matches and from <= date < until (ISO dates, null = open). Later layers override earlier ones field by field. 'source' says whether a value rests on memory of ICC/board playing conditions, on Cricsheet data, or both; reports/cricket-rules-validation.json checks every data-testable field and docs/cricket-rules.md explains each data-vs-memory conflict.

conventions.names: Field names follow CRICKET-MODEL-PLAN.md section 5. rules_for also returns the earlier names noball_extra_runs, test_days, powerplay_overs, fielders_outside, bowler_quota_overs, balls_in_use, super_over and super_over_this_match as deprecated aliases.
conventions.overs: 1-based inclusive over numbers in units of balls_per_over (The Hundred: 5-ball sets, as Cricsheet encodes it)
conventions.balls: pp_windows_reduced is in 1-based inclusive legal balls of the innings
conventions.when_keys: fmt, gender, team_type, competition_id, tier, event_id, official, assoc_match (lists match any element; booleans match exactly), teams_any (at least one team listed), teams_all (every team listed), knockout (bool, from the Cricsheet event stage), stage_regex
conventions.reviews_per_innings: unsuccessful player reviews per team per innings whenever DRS is in use; null when drs_scope is 'none'
conventions.drs_scope: all = every match; selected = some series or broadcast matches only (drs_available false by default); knockouts = playoff/knockout matches only; none = never
conventions.derived: rules_for adds drs_allowed, tie_break (resolved for the match), min_balls_for_result, p_free_hit_given_nb, follow_on_lead and follow_on_lead_by_days, bowler_quota_reduced and pp_windows_reduced (from the *_rule fields and the tables below)

fields.overs_per_innings: scheduled overs per innings (limited overs; Hundred: twenty 5-ball sets)
fields.bowler_quota: maximum overs per bowler per innings at full length (plan: bowler_quota)
fields.bowler_quota_balls: maximum legal balls per bowler per innings at full length
fields.reduced_quota_rule: fifth_min2 (N < 10 overs: 2 each; else floor(N/5) each and N mod 5 bowlers one more) | hundred_balls (B/5 rounded up to whole 5-ball sets, at least 10 balls) | null (multi-day)
fields.pp_windows: {mandatory: [[from, to], ...], batting: {n, overs, window, max_outside} | null, fielding: same | null} at full length (plan: pp_windows)
fields.pp_reduced_rule: name of the reduced-innings powerplay table in reduced_tables (applied with the innings length N known at the time)
fields.field_restr: [[from_over, to_over, max_fielders_outside_circle], ...] outside optional powerplay blocks (plan: field_restr)
fields.noball_penalty_runs: penalty runs for a no-ball (1, or 2 in English domestic competitions); Cricsheet extras.noballs above this value include byes or leg-byes run off the no-ball
fields.drs_available: DRS in use for a typical match of this competition and date (competition default)
fields.umpires_call_retains_review: an unsuccessful review that is umpire's call does not cost a review
fields.review_topup_after_80: Tests: reviews reset to the full allowance after 80 overs of an innings
fields.ucall_zone_era: pre_2016 | 2016_wider (stump zone widened to the outer edge of the stumps) | 2021_higher (zone raised to the top of the bails); era anchors for the DRS model
fields.new_ball_after_overs: overs after which a new ball may be taken (multi-day)
fields.two_new_balls: one new ball from each end (ODIs from October 2011)
fields.two_new_balls_until_over: with two_new_balls: the fielding side keeps one of the two balls after this over (34 from July 2025); null = both balls all innings
fields.tactical_sub: none | supersub (ODI supersub 2005-06 and the BBL X-factor 2020-22) | impact_player
fields.tie_break: none (ties stand) | bowl_out | so_boundary_count (one super over, then boundary count) | so_repeat (super overs until a winner) | knockout_only (config only: knockouts use so_boundary_count before 2019-10-14 and so_repeat after, other matches none)
fields.min_overs_for_result: overs each side must be able to face for a result (Hundred: 5-ball sets)
fields.max_consecutive_balls_per_end: Hundred: a bowler bowls 5 or 10 consecutive balls
fields.slow_over_rate_fielding_penalty: informational: in-match penalty of one fewer fielder outside the circle
fields.caught_crossing_counts: after a catch, batters who crossed stay crossed (the new batter may go to the non-striker's end); false = new batter always on strike (Law 18.11, October 2022)

follow_on_lead_by_days.note: Law 14.1: 200 for five days or more, 150 for three or four, 100 for two, 75 for one. Under Law 14.1.3, when no play takes place on the first day the days are counted from the day play starts. Data: every five-day follow-on has lead >= 200 except Ireland v Pakistan 2018 (day 1 lost, lead 180 >= 150); four-day minimum 150.

p_free_hit_given_nb.note: Front-foot-only free-hit eras: share of no-balls followed by a free hit, 1 - (protected dismissals on the next ball / expected at the over-by-over base rate), shrunk to the pooled front-foot ratio with a Gamma prior worth 10 expected dismissals (see the free_hit rows of reports/cricket-rules-validation.json). Eras with free_hit none give 0 and all_noballs give 1.

reduced_tables.t20_overs: T20 reduced innings: powerplay of round_half_up(0.3 N) whole overs (5-8 overs: 2, 9-11: 3, 12-14: 4, 15-18: 5, 19: 6)
reduced_tables.t20_balls: T20 reduced innings: powerplay of round_half_up(1.8 N) balls (30% of the balls; 5 overs: 9 balls = 1.3 overs)
reduced_tables.t20_surge: BBL/WBBL power-surge era: first powerplay of max(2, ceil(0.2 N)) whole overs (data: 5-over innings record 2); the 2-over power surge is left at full length
reduced_tables.odi_p123_men: men's ODI 2015+: P2 = round_half_up(0.6 N) overs, the rest split P1 = ceil(R/2), P3 = floor(R/2); fielders outside 2 / 4 / 5
reduced_tables.odi_p1_round: ODI one-powerplay eras and women's ODIs: P1 = round_half_up(N/5) overs with 2 outside; the full-length outfield limit after it
reduced_tables.hundred_quarter: The Hundred: powerplay of round_half_up(0.25 B) balls for B = 5 N balls (low confidence)

layers.note: Data: every T20 competition records a 6-over mandatory powerplay and 20 overs; bowler maximum 24 legal balls; D/L results need 5 overs a side.

Data: in innings reduced before they began, bowlers keep to floor(N/5) overs with N mod 5 of them allowed one more (797 of 803 innings; below 10 overs every bowler may bowl 2), and the recorded powerplay follows round_half_up(0.3 N) whole overs. Innings cut after the powerplay keep 6 overs and bowlers who had already passed the new quota.

data_anomalies.explanation: Two 19-over BBL matches (1152515, 1152565) record a 5-over powerplay in both innings, where round_half_up(0.3 x 19) gives 6: rounding down, as in the earliest T20 seasons (IPL 2008, T20Is 2007). Other BBL seasons round half up.
The 2014 One-Day Cup mixes rounding: where floor and round_half_up of N/5 differ, 4 innings round down and 5 round half up; the rest of the unmatched innings were cut during the powerplay.
One 48-over women's ODI (1168164) records a 9-over powerplay in both innings (floor of 48/5) instead of 10.
The first WBBL power-surge season records 2-over powerplays for 12- and 13-over innings (1323574, 1323594) where ceil(N/5) gives 3; later WBBL and BBL seasons follow max(2, ceil(N/5)).

The Hundred's reduced powerplay rests on 13 scored innings and no published table: 25-80-ball innings follow round_half_up(B/4) (9 of 9), but 85- and 90-ball innings record 20 balls (3 innings) and one 65-ball chase 15. Low confidence.

The 2025 Zimbabwe T20I tri-series in Harare (Zimbabwe, New Zealand, South Africa) had no DRS, while the Pakistan tri-series with Zimbabwe did. The default is per team, so New Zealand v South Africa in Harare stays 'all'; per-match drs_available is false there through the series key.

England's 2011 'NatWest Series' is two bilateral series under one name: England v Sri Lanka (5 ODIs, no reviews recorded) and England v India (DRS without ball-tracking; reviews in 2 of 5). The series key splits NatWest Series by team pair from 2006, so per-match drs_available is right; only this event-level row pools them.

Australia show three failed fielding reviews before over 80 of the West Indies second innings at Melbourne (match 892517); the allowance was two. Likely a mis-attributed or untagged review.
